content: We introduce RUN, a new task and dataset for NL navigation in realistic urban environments. We collected (and verified) NL navigation instructions aligned with actual paths, and propose a strong neural baseline for the task. Our ablation studies show the significant contribution of each of the components we propose. In the future we plan to extend the world-state representation, and enable the model to ground generic and abstract concepts as well. We further intend to add additional signals, for instance coming from vision (cf. BIBREF16), for more accurate localization.
